title: No Certificate, No Categorical Speech Act: A Brouwerian Assertibility Constraint for Public Reason
abstract: arXiv:2603.03971v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI can convert uncertainty into authoritative-seeming verdicts, displacing the justificatory work on which democratic epistemic agency depends. As a corrective, I propose a Brouwer-inspired assertibility constraint for responsible AI: in high-stakes domains, systems may assert or deny claims only if they can provide a publicly inspectable and contestable certificate of entitlement; otherwise they must return Undetermined. This constraint yields a three-status interface semantics (Asserted, Denied, Undetermined) whose statuses mark entitlement to categorical speech rather than truth values of the underlying world-claim. The framework distinguishes internal entitlement from public standing while connecting them through the certificate as a boundary object. translated_title: 无证书，无断言语语行为：面向公共理性的布劳威尔式可断言性约束
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能能够将不确定性转化为看似权威的裁定，从而取代民主认识能动性所依赖的论证工作。作为纠正措施，我提出一种受布劳威尔启发的负责任AI可断言性约束：在高风险领域，系统只有在能够提供可公开检验、可公开质疑的资格证明（certificate of entitlement）时，才可以断言或否认某一命题；否则必须返回“未定”。该约束产生了一种三值接口语义（已断言、已否认、未定），其状态标记的是作出断言语语行为的资格，而非底层世界命题的真值。该框架区分了内部资格与公共地位，并通过作为边界对象的证书将二者联系起来。在哲学层面，它发展了一种应用直觉主义的形式：对无根据完备性的抵抗成为公共机器言说的规范，在此规范之下，断言性的……
tldr: 该论文提出一种受布劳威尔启发的“可断言性约束”，要求高风险领域的AI系统只有在能提供可公开检验且可质疑的资格证明时才可作出断言或否认，否则必须返回“未定”，以防止生成式AI将不确定性伪装成权威裁定。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Brouwer-inspired assertibility constraint requiring AI systems in high-stakes domains to assert or deny claims only when they can provide publicly inspectable and contestable certificates of entitlement, and otherwise return "Undetermined," thereby preventing generative AI from converting uncertainty into authoritative-seeming verdicts.
